accounting_notes: Combined Comcast+future NBCUniversal/Sky distribution claims; exclude already separated Versant and sold Sky Germany from forward years. July15 basic shares include ClassB, add Q2 6m dilutive proxy. GAAP-like EBIT retains SBC; no SBC addback or assumed future buyback accretion/dilution. Capex includes cash software/intangibles and property; program amortization remains in expense and content investment timing in NWC. Debt includes consolidated Beijing; operating leases remain operating expense, not duplicated debt. Senior claims7882=5097 deferred compensation (Dec2025 latest detailed obligation)+185 redeemableNCI+1500 analyst minority fair-value reserve+1100 unfundedAtairos reserve. Otherassets4576=50% June7828 noncurrent investments+662 Dec2025 life-insurance offset. No Hulu/Versant value. ITV full up-to consideration conservatively charged as2027 reinvestment2167.36 (Massive GBPUSD1.3546 September7 daily close, no speculative earnings credit); no separate claim deduction. Base corporate expense includes 40m Atairos fee, incremental separation/dual-company costs; taxes normalize. Noncommonclaim uncertainty stressed separately. Deferred compensation reserve treated as a present claim; its cash settlement is excluded from future operating NWC to avoid double deduction. Cash reserve is analyst assumption, not legally restricted.
